how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-alterac-mountains-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:500:obj:0: Gather 9 Dirty Knucklebones from Crushridge ogres in the ⟦E1⟧. Bring them to Marshal Redpath in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:500:details:0: Crushridge ogres have dug an ogre mound up in the ⟦E1⟧ near the ruined city of Alterac. And my scouts tell me they've taken over those ruins as well.
rows.quest:500:details:1: BWe can't let them get cozy up there; if they think they're safe where they are, then their next step will be to move down into the foothills, which will put them right at our front door!
rows.quest:500:details:2: BGo north to the ⟦E1⟧ and hunt ogres. Bring me the Dirty Knucklebones they carry and you will earn a nice bounty.
rows.quest:500:completion:0: Very good, ⟦1⟧ You must have hacked through a whole mess of ogres to get all these knucklebones.
rows.quest:500:completion:1: BThat should keep them out of our hair. At least, for a while.
rows.quest:504:obj:0: Slay 10 Crushridge Warmongers, then return to Marshal Redpath in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:504:details:0: Now that you've had a taste of the Crushridge ogres, I want you to really bloody their noses...
rows.quest:504:details:1: BGo into the Ruins of Alterac and seek out the Crushridge Warmongers. I want you to cut down a good number of them - that's the only way those brutes will learn to keep their distance from ⟦E3⟧ territory.
rows.quest:504:completion:0: Very good. Here is your reward.
rows.quest:504:completion:1: BAnd when you were hunting those Warmongers, how did Alterac city look? It's in bad shape I would guess. Ogres are not known for their cleanliness.
rows.quest:504:completion:2: BThankfully, your efforts will help keep them away from ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:505:obj:0: Kill 12 ⟦E4⟧ Footpads and 8 ⟦E4⟧ Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:505:details:0: I am the new magistrate of ⟦E2⟧, recently assigned after the assassination of the previous magistrate. The assassins were never found, but through our investigations we're almost certain they were hired by the ⟦E4⟧ - a group of thieves led by villainous nobles of the now fallen kingdom of Alterac.
rows.quest:505:details:1: BThe ⟦E4⟧ has a camps in Sofera's Naze and Corahn's ⟦E5⟧, north and west of the ⟦E6⟧-occupied Tarren Mill. Slay the ⟦E4⟧ members you find in these camps.
rows.quest:505:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦2⟧. Although they may still be lurking about, we hope that some of the thieves and footpads you slew were responsible for the last magistrate's death. But even if they weren't, the ⟦E4⟧ is a taint on this land and a stain on the human race.
rows.quest:510:obj:0: Bring the Foreboding Plans to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:510:details:0: Among these documents is a list of requested supplies. These include mundane items (food, weapons, clothing) as well as more exotic gear (masks, oil, poison).
rows.quest:510:details:1: BBut what is most notable is the urgency of the request - these supplies were needed soon in order to undertake what is described in the document as an "important mission against ⟦E2⟧."
rows.quest:510:completion:1: BThese are very troubling, ⟦4⟧. From the information in these documents, and from the ⟦E4⟧'s actions in the past, we must assume that band of cutthroats has waged war on ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:511:obj:0: Bring the Encrypted Letter to Loremaster Dibbs in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:511:details:0: One of the letters on this table is encrypted and inscrutable.
rows.quest:511:completion:0: What is this? Hold a moment... let me take a closer look.
rows.quest:511:completion:2: BHm, I have never before seen this form of encryption, but I must admit that my knowledge in that area is by no means complete.
rows.quest:512:obj:0: Bring 7 Alterac Signet Rings to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:512:details:0: I fear the leadership behind the ⟦E4⟧ is bent on ⟦E2⟧'s ruin. We must strike hard at these leaders before their plans are realized.
rows.quest:512:details:1: BEnter the ruins of Strahnbrad, in the ⟦E1⟧ to the north. We think the ⟦E4⟧ is using the area as a headquarters.
rows.quest:512:details:2: BWe know this gang of cutthroats is run by former Alterac nobles. They may be hiding as normal ⟦E4⟧ agents, but you'll know you've killed a noble by the signet ring he wears.
rows.quest:512:completion:0: Stripping the ⟦E4⟧ of its nobility will remove its ability to act decisively, and reduce it to nothing more than a gang of thugs.
rows.quest:514:obj:0: Take the Cleverly Encrypted Letter to Prospector Stormpike in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:514:details:0: I have a colleague in ⟦E7⟧ who may be able to help decrypt this letter. Go to the Library in the Hall of Explorers in ⟦E7⟧ and speak with Prospector Stormpike. Tell him I sent you and show him the letter. If there's anyone north of Blackrock Spire who can read this, it is he.
rows.quest:514:completion:0: Ah, encryption! A specialty of mine. Let me see here...
rows.quest:522:obj:0: Bring the Assassin's Contract to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:522:details:0: This is a contract for the assassination of Magistrate Henry Maleb. It was sealed and stamped in red wax, using a distinctive signet ring.
rows.quest:522:completion:1: BThat explains the latest attack on ⟦E2⟧. The ⟦E4⟧ must be after me, just as they were the last magistrate!
rows.quest:523:obj:0: Bring the Head of Baron Vardus to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:523:details:0: The contract you recovered was signed by Baron Vardus, a noble of the former kingdom of Alterac, and one known for a cold heart and brutal practices. I'm not surprised someone like the Baron was behind this.
rows.quest:523:details:1: BFind this man. Find him, and bring him to justice. He must be among the ⟦E4⟧ haunts - perhaps at the ruins of Strahnbrad, or perhaps within the valley north of them.
rows.quest:523:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦7⟧. My head rests a little easier, knowing that villain lost his.
rows.quest:525:obj:0: Bring the Decrypted Letter to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:525:details:0: I decrypted the letter, but I don't know what to make of it. You found this among thieves in the Alterac foothills? Very strange...
rows.quest:525:details:1: BYou should take this to the magistrate of ⟦E2⟧. Although this letter is cryptic, his is the closest town to Alterac; if a threat is brewing, then he should know.
rows.quest:525:completion:1: BThis is translated from a letter you found in a ⟦E4⟧ encampment? This was not written by a thief, or even a noble of Alterac.
rows.quest:525:completion:2: BIt appears The ⟦E4⟧ has ties to another power, and I shudder to think what that might be.
rows.quest:535:obj:0: Bring a mug of ⟦E2⟧ Stout to Valik in the ⟦E4⟧ camp.
rows.quest:535:details:0: Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the enemy.
rows.quest:535:details:1: BNo doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some ⟦E2⟧ stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.
rows.quest:535:completion:0: Given my impending death, I think I can safely say that this is the sweetest tasting thing ever... Here, take this, won't do me any good when I'm dead.
rows.quest:537:obj:1: BBring the Head of Nagaz to Magistrate Maleb in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:537:details:0: The letter you brought me was written by a being who calls himself Nagaz, a member of the Argus Wake. I don't know what this Argus Wake is, but if they're in alliance with the ⟦E4⟧ then they must be a threat.
rows.quest:537:details:1: BI want you to find Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages mentioned in that letter. I want you to find them, and kill them.
rows.quest:537:details:2: BSearch in the Uplands, where the ⟦E4⟧ is strongest. It is north of Strahnbrad.
rows.quest:537:details:3: BWith luck, you'll find these envoys of the Argus Wake there.
rows.quest:537:completion:0: Well done, ⟦9⟧. The Argus Wake does not sound like a group we want running the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:537:completion:1: BAnd although you may have destroyed their leader here, Nagaz was merely the servant of another. The Argus Wake might run deep through the continent of ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:551:obj:0: Take the Ensorcelled Parchment to Loremaster Dibbs in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:551:details:0: This parchment is enchanted with a spell, rendering it indecipherable. But one word at the top of the paper can be read:
rows.quest:551:completion:1: BI wish I had the talents to decrypt all the strange bits of writing that trickle down from Alterac. But I'm afraid I lack the knowledge.
rows.quest:554:obj:0: Take the Ensorcelled Parchment to Prospector Stormpike in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:554:details:0: Prospector Stormpike is a master of decryption and deciphering. If you take the parchment you found to him, then with luck he can make sense of it. Stormpike is currently studying in the Prospector headquarters in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:554:details:1: BAnd when you see him tell him you spoke with me - I've been sending him quite a lot of business lately.
rows.quest:554:completion:0: A wise decision. I don't believe there is a scholar other than myself with the skills to translate this scroll. And if its contents prove interesting, fear not. I will send for you.
